audit.why: Lane difficulty (TRICKY, 7/10) fits a 50.39% WR ranged-control matchup: hard early poke, Swain 6 spike, Azir item scaling.

audit.why: Content win[] and packet levelChart agree (Azir, Swain, Skill, Skill, Swain, Azir, Azir) and the existing full whys for rows 1 and 4 already describe Swain winning; only the side tokens lagged.
audit.corrected: phases[1].side=Swain, phases[4].side=Swain, phases[5].side=Azir with matching why rewrite. win[] already correct — side-only edits per the chart rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no cooldown number; the Azir E shield-absorbs-burst interaction (missingInteractions) was implied but never stated with numbers; Swain E is a projectile a Wind Wall-class effect blocks but Azir has none, so nothing to add there.
audit.why: Azir E (Shifting Sands) is a 22/20.5/19/17.5/16s shield-dash — his only escape and a burst absorber; Azir Q is 14s/70 mana at rank 1. Azir R is terrain that knocks back and interrupts Swain's engage but Demonic Ascension itself is not a channel and continues.
audit.corrected: Real cooldown numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns; shield-dash window kept as the tracked ability.

audit.why: Kit gives Azir E 22s rank 1 and Q 14s/70 mana rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad pastes under unrelated titles (COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.why: Title promises W follow-up / half-HP positioning; body explained something else.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to match their titles, grounded in kit numbers.

edits.before: Liandry's spike: the drain outpaces their damage in any extended fight. Force rivers, root the entry, ascend, profit.
edits.after: His Nashor's/Blackfire spike: layered soldier DPS out-ranges the drain and his E dash kites your Ascension. Flank, don't duel.

edits.before: - Azir Shifting Sands: matchup-defining — His shield-dash to a soldier — engage the window after he burns it. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Nevermove for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Azir Shifting Sands: matchup-defining — a 22s shield-dash at rank 1 (16s max), his only escape AND a shield that eats your burst. Force it, then go. - Conquering Sands is 14s and 70 mana at rank 1 — sidestep one and poke free for ten seconds.

edits.before: E his step-up, passive-pull the root for the chunk + heal, Q the retreat — every landed root is a won trade with a health refund attached.
edits.after: Rooted targets can't dodge — Nevermove into Vision of Empire is a guaranteed hit, and the slow tags his walk-back so your Q lands twice more.

edits.before: Brawling pre-6 like the demon is already online — Swain without R is a slow mage with a dream and a root on cooldown.
edits.after: At half HP you are one Conquering Sands poke from kill range — his soldiers reach past 700 units and you heal nothing without R.

notes: Content win[] already matched the packet chart, so side-only edits per the chart rule (rows 1 and 4 whys already described Swain winning). Missing interaction 'Azir E shield absorbs burst' now stated explicitly in breakdown.cooldowns. Azir R (Emperor's Divide) knockback vs mid-Ascension Swain: Ascension is not a channel so it displaces but does not cancel — kit text supports displacement only, so I did not assert a cancel anywhere. Report[] left untouched except none needed.
